description: After settlement: withdrawResidual (closes the sponsor position and pays the residual), redeem the wallet's synth if redemption is open, or claim a top-up. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data (to, data, value, gas) for the user's own wallet; simulated against the latest block first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

owner.description: The user's wallet address (0x...). Used to read the position and as the simulated sender; nothing is signed.

name: prepare_close_and_redeem
title: Prepare close and redeem
